unchanged_rules.OR: exact 10:00,10:05,10:10 fully completed M5; fixed from 10:15; no second OR
unchanged_rules.sweep: first daily side: 1 dated tick beyond OR; reclaim same or next M5 >= 2 ticks inside, with opposing OR bound preserved
unchanged_rules.entry: signal close; wait one FULL completed M5; submit at next boundary; model exact next M5 Open conditional, no T10/T15/FAST
unchanged_rules.stop: past episode extreme plus/minus one dated tick
unchanged_rules.exits: STOP_FIRST; no same-entry-bar TP; adverse stop gap at worse Open; time/session flat before boundary
unchanged_rules.opportunity: first episode per side/day consumed; no recycling filtered attempts
unchanged_rules.research_account: independent same-day positions; overnight restart only conditional; UNKNOWNS never filled-in
unchanged_rules.protected: old v1 code/config/results untouched; TradingSystemLab untouched; M1 and 2024+ replay prohibited

fixes.ATR14: SMA of 14 last observed completed M5 True Ranges, inclusive sweep close, using entire available historical M5 prefix through sweep (including prior sessions and pre-10:00 observations). Each valid current bar has TR max(H-L, abs(H-prev_close), abs(L-prev_close)) ONLY when immediately previous valid bar starts 5 minutes earlier; otherwise TR=H-L to avoid artificial overnight/session jumps. Require 14 genuine observed TR values, no synthetic bars. If invalid/zero-volume source row, reset continuity for TR but retain earlier observed TR values. No recalc using future reclaim, waiting or entry bars.
fixes.ATR_threshold: sweep excursion >= max(1 historical tick, 0.30 * ATR14); unchanged from v1
fixes.MTF_veto: At reclaim close use latest available exact full M15 aggregate from M5. For SHORT veto only if this M15 closes STRICTLY ABOVE frozen OR_HIGH (acceptance of upper breakout); for LONG veto only if this M15 closes STRICTLY BELOW OR_LOW. Otherwise allow even if M15 candle has same direction as sweep. If no valid parent, mark MTF_NO_CONTEXT_NEUTRAL and allow, never silently impute parent.
fixes.filter_order: B ATR only; C M15 acceptance-veto only; D both. A remains no indicator/no MTF. All use same fixed sweep/reclaim signal set and shared entry/exit engine.
fixes.safety: Do not change fill model, exits, cost, calendar, source or events. The alternative v2 research-only results have annual Net/PF/DD=null when unknown/incomplete and cannot authorize live trading.
fixes.separate_original: v1 strict replay/artefacts and existing daywise v1 not modified. V2 uses new config, new run report and separate result directory.

acceptance: independent raw-input forward/backward calculations; fixed 16 cases and 12-month rows; report raw/filt/signal/filled/closed/UNKNOWN counts, C1/C2 PF(price)/PF(R), Net R, largest winner share and MTF/ATR ablation; no 2024 WF/2025+ OOS/Stage 3
